ledger: Dancer's arms | right arm extended outward and lifting, left arm hanging down at side at 00:00 | right arm curved overhead, left arm down at side at 00:09 | at 00:02 the arms instantaneously swap handedness (left arm snaps to raised overhead pose while right arm is down), then snap back to the right arm raised at 00:03

Dancer's feet and floor contact | both bare feet planted on the wood floor with right foot slightly forward and left foot back at 00:00 | weight supported on planted right foot with left foot pointed on the floor at 00:09 | at 00:02 the planted feet instantaneously swap forward/back stance without stepping, then snap back to original foot placement at 00:03

findings.description: At 00:02, the foreground dancer instantaneously snaps into a horizontally mirrored pose mid-action: her raised right arm switches to a raised left arm, her lowered left arm switches to the right side, and her planted feet swap forward/backward stance without any stepping motion, before snapping back to the original right-arm-raised pose and foot placement at 00:03.
